
```{r setup}
library(codeSimData)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Data preparation and setup
We first load in surface feature data, identify the feature centres, and load the flow fields.

```{r load_data}
# Dimples
dimplesField <- re1000weInf$dimples
dimples <- find.vortices.over.time(dimplesField)

# Scars
scarsField <- re1000weInf$scars
scars <- find.scars.over.time(scarsField)

# Surface divergence and vertical vorticity
surfDiv <- re1000weInf$surfDiv
vortZ <- re1000weInf$vortZ

# Integral scales
lengthscale <- re1000weInf$lengthscale # Pixels per integral length scale
timescale <- re1000weInf$timescale # Timestep per integral time scale
```


We select which snapshots to use, and which lags to use.
```{r select_times}
lags <- c(-1, 0, 1)
timesteps <- seq(from = 2, to = length(dimples) - max(lags), by = ceiling(timescale))
radii <- c(1:ceiling(lengthscale*3))

lx <- dim(surfDiv)[2]
ly <- dim(surfDiv)[3]
```

# Data analysis

The model for the intensity of the scars and dimples is intensity = a*Z^b, where Z is a covariate calculated from the
flow field. Z is constant within each pixel, so the likelihood is calculated exactly as a sum over the pixels.

We calculate the profile log likelihood for the global model, where Z is the mean square of the field over each
snapshot:

```{r log_lik_global_model}
sDiv_global <- make.global.result.vectors(lags = lags,
                                          field = surfDiv,
                                          scars = scars,
                                          dimples = dimples,
                                          l_x = lx,
                                          l_y = ly,
                                          tidspunkt = timesteps)

vortZ_global <- make.global.result.vectors(lags = lags,
                                           field = vortZ,
                                           scars = scars,
                                           dimples = dimples,
                                           l_x = lx,
                                           l_y = ly,
                                           tidspunkt = timesteps)
```

We calculate the profile log likelihood for the local model, where Z is the variance of the field within a circle of
radius r:
```{r log_lik_local_model}
sDiv_log_lik <- make.result.matrices(radiar = radii,
                                     lags = lags,
                                     field = surfDiv,
                                     scars = scars,
                                     dimples = dimples,
                                     l_x = lx,
                                     l_y = ly,
                                     tidspunkt = timesteps)

vortZ_log_lik <- make.result.matrices(radiar = radii,
                                      lags = lags,
                                      field = vortZ,
                                      scars = scars,
                                      dimples = dimples,
                                      l_x = lx,
                                      l_y = ly,
                                      tidspunkt = timesteps)
```

`make.logLik.matrix` gives the same result by fitting the model with `mppm` from spatstat, but is much slower. It is
still needed for experimental data, which `make.result.matrices` does not support yet.


# Results and plots
We compare the global and local models. Positive values here imply the local model outperforms the global model.
```{r glob_vs_loc}
print(paste("DimpDiv", max(sDiv_log_lik$dimples) - max(sDiv_global$dimples)))
print(paste("DimpVort", max(vortZ_log_lik$dimples) - max(vortZ_global$dimples)))
print(paste("ScarDiv", max(sDiv_log_lik$scars) - max(sDiv_global$scars)))
print(paste("ScarVort", max(vortZ_log_lik$scars) - max(vortZ_global$scars)))
```


We plot the resulting profile log likelihood for the local model.
```{r plot_data}
plot_data <- expand.grid(r = radii/lengthscale, tau = lags/timescale)
plot_data$dimpDiv <- array(t(sDiv_log_lik$dimples))
plot_data$scarDiv <- array(t(sDiv_log_lik$scars))
plot_data$dimpVort <- array(t(vortZ_log_lik$dimples))
plot_data$scarVort <- array(t(vortZ_log_lik$scars))

dimpDiv_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = r, y = tau, fill = dimpDiv)) + geom_raster()
scarDiv_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = r, y = tau, fill = scarDiv)) + geom_raster()
dimpVort_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = r, y = tau, fill = dimpVort)) + geom_raster()
scarVort_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = r, y = tau, fill = scarVort)) + geom_raster()
```
